q: What does a gate-to-gate carbon footprint mean?
title: Gate-to-gate footprint meaning
short: It covers only what happens inside your own plant: the energy and fuel used from the moment materials arrive to the moment the product leaves. It leaves out raw materials and delivery. Buyers often want cradle-to-gate, so say clearly which one you are sending.

ul: Cradle-to-gate: raw materials plus your processes.

p: It is the part you control and can measure from your own bills. It is a good starting point before you collect supplier data.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
